ennea_q1: I hold myself to high standards and notice what is wrong.
ennea_q2: I feel good when I help others and am needed.
ennea_q3: Success and being recognised matter a lot to me.
ennea_q4: I feel different from others and value deep, true feelings.
ennea_q5: I need time alone to think and understand things fully.
ennea_q6: I think about what could go wrong and value loyalty and security.
ennea_q7: I love new experiences and keep my options open.
ennea_q8: I am direct, I take charge and I protect the people I care about.
ennea_q9: I avoid conflict and like peace and harmony around me.
ennea_r0: The Reformer|Principled and honest; you want to make things right. Remember that good enough is sometimes enough.
ennea_r1: The Helper|Warm and generous; people feel cared for around you. Let others care for you too.
ennea_r2: The Achiever|Driven and adaptable; you turn goals into results. Your worth is more than your wins.
ennea_r3: The Individualist|Creative and sensitive; you see beauty others miss. Your feelings are a gift, not a burden.
ennea_r4: The Investigator|Curious and insightful; you understand things deeply. Share what you know — people want to hear it.
ennea_r5: The Loyalist|Reliable and responsible; you are a true friend. Trust yourself as much as others trust you.
ennea_r6: The Enthusiast|Joyful and spontaneous; you bring energy everywhere. Depth can be as exciting as novelty.
ennea_r7: The Challenger|Strong and protective; you stand up for what is right. Gentleness is a strength too.
ennea_r8: The Peacemaker|Calm and accepting; you bring people together. Your own wishes matter as much as theirs.
attach_q1: I worry that the people I love will leave me.
attach_q2: I need a lot of reassurance that I am loved.
attach_q3: When someone does not reply, I imagine the worst.
attach_q4: I fear being too much for others.
attach_q5: I feel uncomfortable when someone gets very close to me.
attach_q6: I prefer not to depend on others.
attach_q7: I find it hard to talk about my feelings.
attach_q8: I need a lot of space in a relationship.
attach_r0: Secure|You trust and can be trusted; closeness and freedom both feel natural. Keep building relationships where both people feel safe.
attach_r1: Anxious|You love deeply and fear losing it. Saying what you need, calmly, works better than guessing — and you are worth staying for.
attach_r2: Avoidant|You value independence and protect your space. Letting someone in a little at a time will not take your freedom away.
attach_r3: Fearful|You want closeness but it also scares you. Go slowly, choose kind people, and be gentle with yourself; trust grows step by step.

esteem_q2: I believe I have real strengths.
esteem_q3: I can handle most problems that come my way.
esteem_q5: I often feel I am not good enough.
esteem_q6: I compare myself with others and feel worse.
esteem_q7: I find it hard to accept compliments.
esteem_q8: I am very hard on myself after a mistake.
esteem_r0: Your inner critic is loud|You are harder on yourself than you would ever be on a friend. Start each day by naming one thing you did well.
esteem_r1: Steady but shaky|You often value yourself, but doubts come back. Notice your progress and talk to yourself like a good friend.
esteem_r2: Healthy self-esteem|You see your strengths and accept your limits. Keep protecting that kindness toward yourself.

intro_r0: Introvert|You recharge in quiet and think deeply. Plan time alone after busy days — it is how you shine.
intro_r1: Ambivert|You move between both worlds: social when you want, quiet when you need. Listen to which one today asks for.
intro_r2: Extrovert|People and action give you energy. Remember that quiet moments help your ideas grow too.

eq_q2: You feel angry in a meeting.

eq_r2: High emotional intelligence|You understand and manage feelings with care. People feel safe and heard around you.

love_r4: Physical touch|A hug, a hand, closeness: touch makes you feel safe and loved. Ask for it kindly.

dstyle_r0: Rational|You decide with facts and careful thought. Remember that feelings are data too.
